rows.label: bf08140120_0010
rows.name: It's quiet, mo.

rows.label: bf08140120_0020
rows.name: Yes, it is...

rows.label: bf08140120_0030
rows.name:
This world had incredibly advanced
science and technology, mo.

rows.label: bf08140120_0040
rows.name:
Lots of buildings, lots
of people everywhere.

rows.label: bf08140120_0050
rows.name: Everyone must have lived happily here, mo.

rows.label: bf08140120_0060
rows.name: But...

rows.label: bf08140120_0070
rows.name:
No matter how advanced their technology
became, people's true nature never changes.

rows.label: bf08140120_0080
rows.name:
The technology that was meant to improve
their lives ended up destroying everything.

rows.label: bf08140120_0090
rows.name: Now it's... nothing but ruins.

rows.label: bf08140120_0100
rows.name:
Hana was made with science and technology
too, mo!

rows.label: bf08140120_0110
rows.name: Could Hana also...

rows.label: bf08140120_0120
rows.name:
...someday end up
destroying the world...?

rows.label: bf08140120_0130
rows.name: The same goes for me.

rows.label: bf08140120_0140
rows.name: If this is truly [System:Ruby rt=Father's ]God's[/System:Ruby] world...

rows.label: bf08140120_0150
rows.name:
Then that makes me no different.
[System:Ruby rt=Father ]God[/System:Ruby] created me too...

rows.label: bf08140120_0160
rows.name: Are Hikari and Hana the same, mo?

rows.label: bf08140120_0170
rows.name: Yes, I suppose we are.

rows.label: bf08140120_0180
rows.name:
Then... If Hana ever tried
to destroy the world...

rows.label: bf08140120_0190
rows.name: If it looks like Hana might destroy Master too...

rows.label: bf08140120_0200
rows.name: Would you destroy Hana, mo?

rows.label: bf08140120_0210
rows.name: Hana...

rows.label: bf08140120_0220
rows.name:
Tora-kun made you. You'd never do something
like that. Never.

rows.label: bf08140120_0230
rows.name: But...!

rows.label: bf08140120_0240
rows.name: Hmm[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf08140120_0250
rows.name: Then let's make a promise.

rows.label: bf08140120_0260
rows.name: A promise... mo?

rows.label: bf08140120_0270
rows.name: Yes, a promise.

rows.label: bf08140120_0280
rows.name:
If you really were about
to destroy the world,

rows.label: bf08140120_0290
rows.name: I will grant your wish.

rows.label: bf08140120_0300
rows.name:
But in return, grant
one of my wishes too.

rows.label: bf08140120_0310
rows.name: What are you going to wish for, mo?

rows.label: bf08140120_0320
rows.name:
Are you going to destroy the world too,
Hikari, mo?

rows.label: bf08140120_0330
rows.name:
I'm going to make sure that never happens,
so I don't think so.

rows.label: bf08140120_0340
rows.name: But...

rows.label: bf08140120_0350
rows.name: But?

rows.label: bf08140120_0360
rows.name: Never mind. It's nothing.

rows.label: bf08140120_0370
rows.name: I don't have a wish right now.

rows.label: bf08140120_0380
rows.name: Is it okay if I decide later?

rows.label: bf08140120_0390
rows.name: Understood, mo!

rows.label: bf08140120_0400
rows.name: It's a promise between the two of us, mo.

rows.label: bf08140120_0410
rows.name: What?

rows.label: bf08140120_0420
rows.name:
It's the Nopon-style promise ritual
Master taught me, mo!

rows.label: bf08140120_0430
rows.name:
Raise your hand high like this,
then clap, mo!

rows.label: bf08140120_0440
rows.name: I see...
